parole.testo: Possibly borrowed from Middle Persian dptl (daftar), from Aramaic דפתרא or Classical Syriac ܕܦܬܪܐ.

parole.significato: cypress (Cupressus gen. et spp., particularly Cupressus sempervirens)
parole.testo: From Middle Persian 𐫘𐫡𐫇 (srw /⁠sarw⁠/, “cypress”).
